# Synapse 2.0.5

A fix release: approvals route the way the person answered, instructions you paste arrive whole, and the MCP server is ready for connector directories.

## Fixed

- **An approval goes the way it was answered.** A workflow built with Build with AI could follow a sign-off with a check on `approved`, a field the sign-off never wrote, so every approval took the "no" path. Build with AI now gives the sign-off a Yes/No field when the next step branches on it, and checking a workflow refuses any step that reads a field its source never writes. A workflow that already has this mistake now shows an error saying how to fix it, instead of quietly routing every approval "no".
- **Instructions you paste arrive whole.** When you paste code from another tool (for example an OpenAI Agents SDK export from Agent Builder), each agent's instructions are copied exactly as written instead of being retyped, so long instructions are no longer shortened. Builds from long pastes are also faster.
- **Pasted text stays as you wrote it.** Dashes and special spaces in a message to Build with AI are kept, and any key in the message is still masked before anything reads it.
- **Yes/No answers understand more words.** "approve", "approved", "accept" and "accepted" count as Yes, and "decline", "declined", "reject" and "rejected" as No, in a sign-off's Yes/No field and in a reply through a channel or the API.

## MCP server

- **Every tool has a title.** Clients such as Claude show each tool by a readable name, as connector directories require.
- **Tools that change or remove things say so.** Tools that edit, replace or delete what is there are marked as such, so clients like Claude ask you before running them. Tools that only add or read are unchanged.
- **A tool's description names only tools you can call.** `update_schedule` now points to `pause_schedule` and `turn_on_schedule`.

## Models

- **OpenRouter knows which app is calling.** Requests to OpenRouter carry Synapse's name and site, so usage through OpenRouter is attributed to the app. Nothing about you or your workspace is sent. Other providers are unchanged.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.5`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.
